'''Dosin''' was a corpulent, bald [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in charge of high-energy concepts at the [[Maw Installation]] weapons facility. The only hair on his head were eyebrows, which were dark and narrow. His lips were so thick that when he smiled, he could balance a stylus on them. He was killed when the [[Death Star prototype|prototype Death Star]] was sucked into a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] at [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].
